newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES CLOSE LOWER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES CLOSE LOWER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Thirteen stocks fell, five rose and eight were flat in 12.2-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index down 1.9 percent to 1,677.3 points.
The remaining four stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index fell 3.4 percent to 136.2 points in 2.8-million-zloty trade.
NFI units fell 1.1 percent to 133.5 zlotys in a 10.6-million-zloty turnover.
